MAIN ISLAND · FISHING DOCK

A cast of good timing.

Watch for faint underwater shapes, wakes, and brief glimpses at the surface. Aim ahead: the rod bends back and the line whips forward before your bait lands. Original bait is a small worm; the lure panel uses a tiny fishing lure. Each cast uses one bait. When a fish bites, tap R repeatedly (or tap Reel in) to pull it in. Two seconds without reeling lets it escape.

Cast directly into the sea on the map. Arrow keys aim · Enter or Space casts · Escape stops fishing.

    MOONWATER ISLAND · WATERSPORTS

    Catch the wake.

    The tow boat is parked at Moonwater Island’s southern dock. Bring your own wakeboard, hold the rope, and ride behind the boat. The boat follows its own safe course. Arrows / WASD steer your rider across the wake; collisions knock you off. The boat then follows the course back to its dock. X finishes your run.

    MAINLAND BEACH · SURF RENTALS

    Catch the southern swell.

    Paddle: arrows or WASD. Press Space / Enter when a crest reaches your board.

    Ride: left/right turn your board. Hold Space for sharper carves. Build speed down the face, climb the lip for air, and point diagonally down the wave to land. Ride near the curl for tube points. P pauses; X returns to the beach.

      SKYSEED FERRY SERVICE

      A ticket to adventure.

      Your sponsored fishing boat is moored here. Steer with WASD or arrows. F starts fishing; X or “Exit boat” gets you out. At a dock you walk off; offshore you dive and swim. E beside your boat lets you climb back in. Crystal Cavern still requires a ferry ticket.

      WELCOME, EXPLORER

      A whole archipelago is waiting.

      Walk with WASD or arrow keys, or use the touch arrows. You can also tap any glowing marker to visit it.

      Press E near a marker to solve a math challenge. Use the interactive tools, ask for a hint, and try as often as you like.

      Earn 5 crystals for each discovery. Spend them on your cottage, garden, and bridge. Walk between the first four islands. Catch five fish to unlock your own boat, then sail to twelve remote islands with their own docks and practice stops. These outer islands can only be reached by boat. Buy a 50-crystal ferry ticket at the main island dock to sail to the fifth island, Crystal Cavern. Your ticket lets you drive the ferry freely with WASD or arrows, and fish from its deck with F. At the bottom of the map, Mainland Beach has sunbathers, umbrellas, and volleyball. Buy an anchor for 50 crystals in Gear, then press Q near the beach to park either boat and go ashore. Use X near a dock to step ashore. Your power meter drains while swimming and riding sea creatures; each correct problem restores 25 power. At zero power you return safely to land and must solve a problem before swimming again. After 8 discoveries, your companion hatches! Every 50 crystals earned unlocks a squishy. Explore 100 discoveries and collect all seven squishies!
